entries.text: Allah's Name to commence with, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.
Alif-Laam-Ra. (These are individual letters of the Arabic alphabet; Allah and His Messenger know their exact meanings.) These are the verses of the Book and the Luminous Qur'aan.
The disbelievers will eagerly desire that if only they had been Muslims.
Leave them to eat and enjoy (life), and the hope (to live long) leads them to amusement; so, they will soon come to know.
And every town that We destroyed had a known written decree for it.
No group may advance its appointed promise nor can it fall behind.
And they (the disbelievers) said, 'O the one upon whom the Qur'aan has been sent, you are indeed insane.'
'Why do you not bring angels to us, if you are truthful?'
We do not send down angels in vain; and if they (angels) descend, they (the disbelievers) would hence not get any respite.
Indeed, We have sent down this Qur'aan, and indeed, We Ourselves are its Protector.
And We indeed sent Messengers before you to the previous nations.
And never does a Messenger come to them but they mock him.
This is how We cause the mockery to enter the hearts of the culprits.
They do not believe in him, and the tradition of earlier nations has passed on (that they were in the same kind of habit of mocking).
And if We open for them a gate in the heaven; that they may ascend into it during the day (so, they would still not believe).
Even then they would say, 'Our sights have been restricted; rather, we have been bewitched by magic.'
And We indeed created towers in the skies, and beautified it for the beholders.
And We have kept it guarded from every accursed devil.
Except the one who goes to listen stealthily, a blazing flame henceforth pursues him.
And We spread out the earth, and placed (mountains as) anchors in it, and therein grew everything by a (proper) measure.
And created livelihoods for you therein, and created those for whom you do not provide sustenance.
And there is not a thing, treasures of which We do not possess. And We do not send it down except by a known measure.
And We sent the winds that fill the clouds with water, We henceforth caused the water to come down from the sky, then gave it to you to drink. And you are not at all its treasurers.
And it is indeed We Who give life and it is We Who cause death, and only We are the Inheritor (i.e. Owner, after their destruction).
And We indeed know those amongst you who went forward, and We indeed know those amongst you who remained behind.
And indeed, only your Lord will raise them all on the Day of Resurrection. Indeed, only He is Ever Wise, All-Knowing.
Indeed, We created man from (dry) sound-emitting clay, which was in reality black reeking mud.
And created Jinn before him, from smokeless fire.
And recall when your Lord said to the angels that 'I am about to create man from sound-emitting clay, which is from black reeking mud.'
'Henceforth, when I have finished shaping him and breathed into him from Myself a distinct honourable soul, you should therefore fall down to him in prostration.'
So, all the angels; each and every one of them, fell down in prostration.
Except Iblees (Satan); he refused to be amongst those who prostrated.
Said Allah, 'O Iblees! What happened to you that you stayed apart from those who prostrated?'
He said, 'It does not befit me to prostrate to a human being whom You have created from sound-emitting clay, which was from black reeking mud.'
Said Allah, 'So, get out from Paradise! That you are the rejected one.'
'And you are indeed accursed until the Day of Judgement!'
He said, 'O My Lord! Grant me respite till the Day when they are to be raised.'
Said Allah, 'You are of those who are given respite.'
'Till the Day of that known time.'
He said, 'O my Lord, I swear by this (assumption of mine) that You led me astray. I will distract them in the earth and I will lead them all astray.'
'Except those amongst them who are Your chosen bondsmen.'
Said Allah, 'This path leads straight towards Me.'
'Indeed, you do not have any control over My bondsmen except those misguided ones who follow you.'
And Hell is indeed the promise for all of them.
It has seven gates; for each gate from amongst them a part is assigned (i.e. for different disbelievers a different area of Hell is fixed).
Indeed, those who fear (Allah) are in the Gardens and fountains.
'Enter in them with peace, in safety.'
And We have extracted out all malice which was in their chests; they are brothers, sitting face to face upon thrones.
Neither any sorrow is to reach them in it, nor are they to be banished from it.
Inform My bondsmen that undoubtedly only I am the Most Forgiving, the Most Merciful.
And only My punishment is painful punishment.
And inform them of Ibrahim's guests.
When they (the angels) came to him and said, 'Salaam', he said, 'We feel afraid of you.'
They said, 'Do not fear, we give you glad tidings of a knowledgeable boy.'
He said, 'Do you give me glad tidings upon (this fact) that old age has reached me? So, of what do you give glad tidings?'
They said, 'We have given you true glad tidings; do not lose hope.'
He said, 'Who can be disappointed from the Mercy of his Lord except those who became misguided?'
He said, 'Then (now) what is your task, O angels?'
They said, 'We have been sent towards a sinning nation.'
'But the family of Loot; we shall rescue all of them.'
'Except his wife; we have decided (with the command of Allah) that she is of those who will stay behind.'
So, when the angels came to the family of Loot.
He said, 'You are some kind of strange people.'
They said, 'Rather, we have brought to you that (punishment) in which these people were doubtful.'
'And we have brought to you a true command, and we are indeed truthful.'
'Therefore, go out with your family whilst a part of the night remains, and you walk behind them, and none of you should turn around to see. And proceed straight to the place you are commanded to.'
And We informed him the decision of this command; that in the morning the root of the disbelievers will be cut off.
And the people of the city came rejoicing (to the house of the Prophet Loot with evil intent).
Loot said, 'These are my guests, do not disgrace me.'
'And fear Allah, and do not humiliate me.'
They said, 'Had we not forbidden you from interfering in the matters of others?'
He said, 'These women of our nation are my daughters, if you must do (marry them and fulfil your desire in the proper manner).'
O Beloved, by the oath of your life; they are indeed wandering about in their intoxication (of misguidance).
So, the (deafening) scream overcame them at sunrise.
So, We made the upper side of that town its lower side (i.e. capsized it) and showered upon them stones of baked clay.
Indeed, in this are signs for people who have insight.
And that town is indeed upon a path which is still functional.
Indeed, in this are signs for the believers.
And the Bush-dwellers (i.e. the nation of the Prophet Shu'ayb) were indeed definitely unjust.
We henceforth took revenge from them; and both of these towns are indeed situated on an open path.
And the people of Hijr (i.e. the rocky tract) indeed belied the Messengers.
And We gave them Our signs, and they kept their faces turned away from them.
And they used to carve out houses in the mountains, without fear.
So, the (deafening) scream overcame them in the morning.
Therefore, their earnings did not benefit them in the least.
And We have not created the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them in vain. And indeed, the Last Day is coming; therefore (O Beloved), pardon graciously.
Indeed, only your Lord is the Great Creator, the All-Knowing.
And We have indeed given you seven verses (i.e. Surah Fatihah) which are often repeated, and the Glorious Qur'aan.

Do not lift your eyes; looking towards that thing (i.e. worldly comforts) which We have given to some pairs (of disbelievers) to enjoy, and do not at all grieve over them, and take the Muslims within the wings of your mercy (i.e. bless them with your kindness).
And say (O Beloved); that 'Only I am a clear Warner (of that punishment).'
Like the one We sent down upon the dividers (the Jews and the Christians).
(They are) those who made the Divine Word into pieces.
So, by your Lord, We shall definitely question them all.
(About) whatever they used to do.
Therefore, publicly announce what you are commanded, and turn away (your) face from the polytheists.
Indeed, We are sufficient for you against these mockers.
Those who ascribe another deity along with Allah; they will henceforth soon come to know.
And We indeed know that you become disheartened by what they say.
Therefore, glorify your Lord whilst praising Him, and be amongst those who prostrate.
And remain worshipping your Lord, until death.
